### Observed differences

- Activity A02 was not observed at all in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it appears in all 200 traces, exactly once per trace (mean 1.0 occurrence, no repeats) — a difference larger than in about 199 of 200 random re-splits. [OCC001, POS002]
- Before, A02 never shared a trace with any other activity; in the later window it co-occurs with each of A01, A03, A04, A05, A06 and A07 in every trace. [REL001, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011]
- A02 sits mid-trace with a flexible position: in the later window it precedes A05 in about 89 in 100 traces and A07 in about 81 in 100, precedes A04 in about 69 in 100, and is close to even with A01 (about 56 vs 44), A03 (45 vs 55) and A06 (51 vs 49); its mean event position is about 0.37 of the trace. [REL001, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, POS002]
- Edges changed accordingly: in the later window A01 leads to A02 in about 24 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (never before), with the share to A04 dropping from about 36 to 19 in 100; A03, A04, A05 and A06 also now lead to A02 (about 24, 9, 28 and 18 in 100 of their outgoing transitions, the A05 figure based on only about 46 transitions). A02's own outgoing transitions go mainly to A04 (about 26 in 100), A06 (25), A01 (19) and A03 (19). [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- The remaining activities shifted slightly later and their mutual step distances stretched: A01's mean event position rose from about 0.29 to 0.35 and A04's from 0.41 to 0.47; A01→A04 within one step fell from about 47 to 26 in 100 while a 4-step gap appeared (0 to about 23 in 100); 5-step gaps that did not exist before now account for about 22 in 100 for A01→A07 and 21 in 100 for A06→A07. [POS001, POS004, LAG002, LAG005, LAG023]
- Pairs not involving A02 kept their relationships essentially unchanged: order shares move by at most about 5–7 in 100, most with low empirical strength. [REL002, REL013, REL014, REL015]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A02 was added to the process: previously unobserved, it is now executed exactly once in every case, placed in the middle portion of each trace — almost always before A05 and A07 and usually before A04, but with no fixed order relative to A01, A03 and A06 — and its insertion pushed the other activities slightly later and stretched the step distances between previously closer activities. This is shown directly and consistently across the indicator families: participation jumps from 0 to 200 of 200 traces, co-occurrence with every other activity rises from never to always, new incoming edges (from A01, A03, A04, A05, A06) and outgoing edges to six activities appear, and the position and lag shifts of the remaining activities match a single inserted event. [OCC001, REL001, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR006, POS002, POS001, POS004, LAG002, LAG005, LAG023]

An important competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A02 already occurred as a rare variant before — 0 of 200 traces does not prove absolute absence — although even then its participation would have changed from rare to universal; the evidence also cannot show whether A02 took over work that was previously unlogged, and the mixed orders mean there is no single fixed insertion point. [OCC001, REL001, REL007, REL010]

Other differences: small shifts in order shares between pre-existing pairs, such as A01 preceding A04 falling from about 73 to 68 in 100 and A03 preceding A04 rising from about 66 to 73 in 100, with only moderate empirical strength; these are consistent with sampling variation or side effects of the insertion and are not part of the main hypothesis. [REL003, REL012, REL004]
